located_evidence.quote:
Jeff Stopar, Legal Counsel, prepared a moratorium Resolution 2026-03-05 imposing a
temporary moratorium on the approval, establishment or construction of advanced
manufacturing facilities or uses within Spencer township for 12 months. After discussion,
Trustee Hood made a motion to approve the Resolution, Trustee Havens seconded. Roll call
vote: Trustee Kester: yes, Trustee Havens: yes, Trustee Hood: yes.

Motion to adopt ordinance 2026-74 by Pavlik, seconded by Epstein. All were in
favor. Motion carried by a vote of 6-0.

SECTION 1. That Council hereby extends the moratorium, for twelve months effective October 13, 2026, that the City

shall not accept, process, or approve any new applications or issue any new permits, licenses, variances, or any zoning

applications from or for data centers within the City of Tallmadge.

SECTION 2. The moratorium shall be in effect for a period of twelve months from the effective date of this ordinance

or until changes are enacted to amend the Codified Ordinances of the City of Tallmadge to address data centers or until

Council approves legislation explicitly revoking this moratorium, whichever occurs first. Council reserves the right to

extend this moratorium if reasonable and necessary.
